The luxury eco-friendly family car, and saga of faults and customer service issues.

![Our car](1.jpeg)

We bought the I-PACE having test drive a number of other EVs and deciding the I-PACE was the best car for us, given it's long range, lots of safety features, awards galore from a manufacturer who's pedigree was strong. Sadly this hasn't been the reality.

The car has been off the road for long periods at a time, for most of 2025 it was at the dealership from March - December. The last module replacement took eight months from initial failure to repair, meaning a drive to visit elderly relatives adds about £60 and 1 hour to the journey that takes about 90 minuets to drive!

Previously JLR provided a courtesy car, which meant we didn't have these issues, but they're now no longer providing them for module replacements in my experience.

So far we have had multiple HV modules replaced, multiple control modules (BCCM) replace, the HV charging port and HV wiring replaced. Following the latest repair, I've been left with a de-bonded protection plate, broken trim. Leaving me with a total loss of faith that the dealership have the competency to carry out any work on the car without breaking something else.

![Debonded Plate](IMG_0775.mov)

In addition to multiple HV issues, the AC failed due to a known quality issue, the Heads Up Display has a hazy affect making it fairly pointless. The Advanced Driving Assistance Systems intermittently fail, or loose sight of detected road or dangers, for example causing it to accelerate towards delivery bikes and similar small vehicles.

![HUD distortion](pic3.jpeg)

Soon it will approach the 8 year / 100Km warranty, and from what other members report, JLR and dealerships won't diagnose or fix any more modules without me risking having to pay for it.

We have been let down by Jaguar, who at one point offered a buy-back but won't pay anything more than the artificially depreciated market value of the car. Given JLR were bailed out by the government, you'd hope they would take their responsibilities more seriously.
